SS-RUNTIME.Purpose: Expose local ancestor context and bounded full-graph discovery as one deterministic pipeline.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Operation `ancestors`: transitive semantic parents of actually read files.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Operation `graph`: one inferred/explicit finite boundary, one full scan, external ancestor-only continuation.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Delivery: scope-keyed context injection with reset semantics.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Widening of the full-discovery region because a parent resolves outside it.

Principles.PRIN-001: Authority: filesystem plus child-owned `parents` declarations; derived state is acceleration/history only.
Principles.PRIN-002: `cwd` may resolve relative CLI paths but is never semantic boundary authority.
Principles.PRIN-003: One process/session may operate on unrelated files/scopes without a session-global project root.

Requirements.REQ-001: `ancestors` requires an existing regular FILE; it never calls `ProjectIndex.scan`; cost depends only on traversed ancestry and literal-lookup depth.
Requirements.REQ-002: `graph` accepts an existing file or directory anchor; a directory anchor selects scope and produces no `focus`.
Requirements.REQ-003: Graph boundary priority: explicit `--root` override -> nearest ancestor containing `.frostline/` -> nearest containing `.git/` -> top-level child of `HOME` containing the anchor; if no safe boundary is inferable, an explicit root is required.
Requirements.REQ-004: `HOME` itself is never inferred as a full-scan root.
Requirements.REQ-005: Graph anchor/focus never creates graph participation.
Requirements.REQ-006: A file with no declaration is a valid `ancestors` no-op; a file with no declaration and no incoming resolved reference is not a graph node.
Requirements.REQ-007: Graph-derived children are an inverse view only, never declaration authority.
Requirements.REQ-008: Discovery/cache state missing or corrupt -> filesystem-derived rebuild; delivery state missing or corrupt -> safe reinjection; required documents cannot be suppressed.
Requirements.REQ-009: DeliveryScope identifiers are opaque and may span files from unrelated graph scopes.
Requirements.REQ-010: Hidden model context is never heuristically reconstructed.
Requirements.REQ-011: An invalid or cyclic branch never destroys independent valid branches.
